resources.string: Network location
Record to a NAS or computer over SMB, WebDAV or FTP. Recordings are saved on this device first and copied across.
Connection type
SMB
WebDAV
FTP
Address
The WebDAV address, for example https://nas.local:5006/recordings
A folder under the address, for example TV/Live. It is created if missing.
Name or IP address, for example nas.local. Add :port only if the server uses a port other than 21.
A folder in the login folder, for example TV/Live. It is created if missing.
Secure (explicit TLS)
Encrypts the login and recordings. The server must support FTPS.
Leave empty to connect without signing in
This connection is not encrypted. Others on the network could see the password.
Check the address and folder names. They cannot contain < > : \" | ? *
Nothing was found at this address. Check the path after the server name.
The server\'s certificate could not be verified. If it is your NAS\'s own certificate, compare the fingerprint with the one shown on the NAS before trusting it.
SHA-256 fingerprint: %1$s
Trust this certificate
The server does not offer encryption. Turn off Secure, or enable FTPS on the server.
The server requires TLS session reuse on data connections, which is not supported. Turn that requirement off on the server.
